no_further_methodology_change: after this spec passes, no methodology change is permitted unless an objective implementation or data-engineering defect is discovered

primary_regression.equation: Y(t) = alpha + beta_j*Z1_j(t) + gamma1*nq_z(t) + gamma2*nq_vol_state(t) + SUM_b delta_b*session_b(t) + gamma3*prev_day_nq_return(t) + eps(t)
primary_regression.beta_j: the ONLY coefficient used for hypothesis j's primary test
primary_regression.development_inference: CR1 cluster-robust covariance clustered by CME trade date, Student-t(G-1)
primary_regression.sign_handling: the expected sign is NOT used to make the development test one-sided; it is a SEPARATE promotion gate
primary_regression.standardization: all continuous predictors are standardized with FROZEN development constants. beta_j is invariant to rescaling of the OTHER regressors, so this affects conditioning only, not the primary test.
forbidden: any model choice made after outcomes

session_coding.definition: hso = hours since the 18:00 ET CME session open, 0..22
session_coding.timezone: ET wall clock via cme_session.session_epoch, so the boundaries are DST-correct by construction and never a fixed UTC offset

categories.name: us_open
categories.et: 09:00-11:00, the 09:30 cash open sits in hso 15

session_coding.reference_irrelevance: beta_j is mathematically invariant to which dummy is omitted - the dummies span the same space - and a test proves it
session_coding.absent_category_rule: FAIL CLEARLY via DesignError; never silently recode

forbidden: switching to the H1/H2 intersection after results are known

block_bootstrap.type: chronological MOVING-BLOCK bootstrap over CME trade dates
block_bootstrap.cluster: the CME trade date is the indivisible unit
procedure: draw contiguous blocks of block_len consecutive development trade dates WITH REPLACEMENT from all start positions
append blocks until at least the original number of development trade dates is collected
truncate to exactly that many WHOLE trade-date clusters
include ALL eligible hourly rows of every selected date, preserving within-date structure
refit the SAME frozen regression in every replicate
do NOT refit scalers - use the frozen development constants

bootstrap_pass_rule.requirement: for EACH of L = 5, 10 and 20 the 95% percentile interval for beta_j must exclude zero in the PREREGISTERED direction
bootstrap_pass_rule.negative_hypotheses: the UPPER endpoint of the 95% interval must be < 0
forbidden: choosing the block length that looks best

concentration_rule.groups: DEVELOPMENT trade dates split chronologically into 10 contiguous, approximately equal-count groups D1..D10
concentration_rule.procedure: 10 leave-one-decile-out refits of the identical frozen model; NO scaler refitting
pass_requires_all: at least 9 of 10 leave-one-decile-out beta estimates retain the preregistered sign
no sign reversal has absolute magnitude greater than the full-development |beta|
the median leave-one-decile-out |beta| is at least 50% of the full-development |beta|
concentration_rule.is: a robustness gate, NOT a new significance test
concentration_rule.no_p_values: no p-value is computed from these ten models for promotion purposes

effect_size_gate.applies_to: |standardized beta_j| from the FULL development regression

all_nine_required: 2 beta sign matches preregistration (NEGATIVE for both)
8 the coefficient is estimated in the full frozen baseline model
9 the design matrix passes rank and conditioning checks
stage_1_promotion.any_failure: the feature does NOT enter replication

stage_2_replication.test: ONE-SIDED in the preregistered NEGATIVE direction
stage_2_replication.two_survivors: Holm correction across the two replication p-values at family alpha = 0.10
stage_2_replication.shrinkage: reported DESCRIPTIVELY; never converted into a gate after outcomes

replication_firewall.rule: replication coefficients, p-values, correlations, plots and directional summaries are NOT computed for a hypothesis that failed Stage 1. Failed hypotheses remain outcome-uninspected in replication.

prospective_firewall.opens_only_after: 126 ELIGIBLE CME trade dates under the frozen eligibility rule

firewall: --dry-run replaces the outcome VALUE function with a poisoned stub that raises; only the bool presence predicate is reachable. --execute additionally requires --i-authorize-outcome-inspection and is disabled in this build.
hash_verification: the runner verifies these before reading any real outcome; any mismatch HALTS
